title: Run a custom analysis question in the workspace
description: A user can enter a natural-language question in the workspace and receive a computed analytical result.

steps.description: Navigate to /workspace
Fill in a custom analytical question
Submit the analysis request
Verify a direct answer is displayed
Verify execution details for the analysis are displayed

title: Run an analysis from the workspace using a suggested question
description: A user can choose a suggested question in the workspace and receive a completed analysis response.

steps.description: Navigate to /workspace
Select a suggested analysis question
Submit the analysis request
Verify a direct answer is displayed
Verify supporting insights and analysis details are displayed

title: Run an analysis from the workspace and review the generated answer
description: This verifies that a user can ask a question in the workspace and receive a completed analysis with supporting insights and a visualization.

steps.description: Navigate to /workspace
Fill in a natural-language analysis question into the question field
Submit the analysis request
Verify a direct answer is displayed
Verify supporting analysis details are displayed
Verify a visualization is displayed

title: Start analyzing from the landing page
description: A new visitor can begin the product experience from the homepage and reach the analysis workspace.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the primary call to action to start analyzing
Verify the analysis workspace is displayed

title: Register a PostgreSQL table for analysis
description: A user can test a PostgreSQL connection, discover database objects, and register a table as the active dataset.

steps.description: Navigate to /settings
Fill in the database host field with a valid value
Fill in the database port field with a valid value
Fill in the database name field with a valid value
Fill in the database username field with a valid value
Fill in the database password field with a valid value
Test the PostgreSQL connection
Verify discovered database objects are displayed
Select a table for analysis
Register the selected table
Verify the active dataset is updated

title: Log in and view the authenticated profile state
description: This verifies that a user can sign in from settings and see the authenticated account state reflected in the page.

steps.description: Navigate to /settings
Fill in the username or email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the sign-in form
Verify an authenticated profile state is displayed
Verify session-related account information is visible

title: Upload a valid dataset and view its profile
description: A user can upload a CSV or XLSX file in the dataset explorer and see the resulting dataset profile.

steps.description: Navigate to /explorer
Upload a valid CSV or XLSX dataset file
Verify the dataset profile is displayed
Verify dataset quality and preview information are displayed

title: Register a discovered table and continue to workspace analysis
description: A user can register a PostgreSQL table and then proceed to the workspace with that dataset ready for analysis.

steps.description: Navigate to /settings
Fill in the database host field with a valid value
Fill in the database port field with a valid value
Fill in the database name field with a valid value
Fill in the database username field with a valid value
Fill in the database password field with a valid value
Test the PostgreSQL connection
Select a table for analysis
Register the selected table
Navigate to /workspace
Verify the analysis workspace is available for the registered dataset

title: Sign out from settings
description: This verifies that a signed-in user can end the session and return to an unauthenticated state.

steps.description: Navigate to /settings
Fill in the username or email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the sign-in form
Sign out of the account
Verify the unauthenticated state is displayed
Verify authenticated profile information is no longer visible

title: View a generated chart from analysis
description: A user can review the visualization rendered for an analysis result in the workspace.

steps.description: Navigate to /workspace
Run or open an analysis that produces a visualization
Verify a visualization is displayed
Verify the chart corresponds to the analysis result

title: Discover PostgreSQL schemas and tables after a successful connection
description: A user can move from valid connection details to viewing the available schemas and tables without registering anything yet.

steps.description: Navigate to /settings
Fill in the database host field with a valid value
Fill in the database port field with a valid value
Fill in the database name field with a valid value
Fill in the database username field with a valid value
Fill in the database password field with a valid value
Test the PostgreSQL connection
Verify schemas and tables are displayed

title: Explore a chart with hover and zoom controls
description: This verifies that a rendered workspace chart supports interactive inspection and view changes.

steps.description: Navigate to /workspace
Run an analysis that returns a visualization
Hover over a data point on the chart
Zoom or pan the chart
Reset the chart view
Verify chart details are revealed on hover
Verify the chart returns to its default view

title: Inspect dataset column quality details
description: A user can review detected columns and their profiling details after a dataset is uploaded.

steps.description: Navigate to /explorer
Upload a valid CSV or XLSX dataset file
Expand or inspect the column-level profiling section
Verify column statistics are displayed
Verify missing rate and cardinality information are displayed

title: Inspect analysis history and reopen a prior result
description: A user can find a previous analysis in history and reopen it in the workspace to continue working.

steps.description: Navigate to /history
Search or scan for a prior analysis record
Open the prior analysis from history
Verify the saved analysis entry is displayed
Verify the analysis is reopened in the workspace

title: Upload a dataset using the file browser
description: A user can browse for a local file, select a dataset, and upload it successfully.

steps.description: Navigate to /explorer
Open the file browser to choose a local dataset file
Select a valid CSV or XLSX file
Verify the dataset upload completes successfully
Verify the dataset profile is displayed

title: Download the workspace chart image
description: This verifies that a user can export a rendered analysis chart for later use.

steps.description: Navigate to /workspace
Run an analysis that returns a visualization
Download the chart image
Verify the chart export completes successfully
Verify the visualization remains displayed

title: Reopen a historical analysis in the workspace
description: This verifies that a user can reopen a saved analysis and continue from the workspace.

steps.description: Navigate to /history
Open an existing history entry
Reopen the selected analysis in the workspace
Verify the workspace opens with a prior analysis loaded
Verify the prior analysis content is displayed

title: Reconnect using previously entered PostgreSQL settings
description: A returning user can revisit settings, reuse connection details, and reach the discovered database objects again.

steps.description: Navigate to /settings
Fill in the database host field with a valid value
Fill in the database port field with a valid value
Fill in the database name field with a valid value
Fill in the database username field with a valid value
Fill in the database password field with a valid value
Test the PostgreSQL connection
Leave the settings page and return to it
Test the PostgreSQL connection again
Verify discovered database objects are displayed

title: Inspect supporting analysis details
description: A user can open expandable analysis details and review the data and execution evidence behind an answer.

steps.description: Navigate to /workspace
Open the analysis details section
Verify supporting data is displayed
Verify SQL or Python execution details are displayed

title: Search previous analyses in history
description: This verifies that a user can find prior analyses by searching the history log.

steps.description: Navigate to /history
Enter a search term into the history search field
Apply the search
Verify matching history entries are displayed
Verify non-matching entries are not shown

title: Choose a different table after discovering database objects
description: A user can inspect discovered tables and switch the selected table before registering it for analysis.

steps.description: Navigate to /settings
Fill in the database host field with a valid value
Fill in the database port field with a valid value
Fill in the database name field with a valid value
Fill in the database username field with a valid value
Fill in the database password field with a valid value
Test the PostgreSQL connection
Select one available table
Select a different available table
Register the selected table
Verify the chosen table is registered as the active dataset

title: Filter history by dataset or analysis type
description: This verifies that a user can narrow the history list using available filters.

steps.description: Navigate to /history
Open the history filter controls
Select a dataset or analysis type filter
Verify the history list updates to the selected filter
Verify the filtered results remain visible

title: Explore the landing page product sections
description: A visitor can review the homepage content and continue into the product experience from the landing page.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll through the landing page product sections
Verify product overview content is displayed
Verify a navigation path into the product experience is available

title: Update PostgreSQL connection details before retesting
description: A user can change previously entered PostgreSQL credentials and retest the connection with the updated values.

steps.description: Navigate to /settings
Fill in the database host field with a valid value
Fill in the database port field with a valid value
Fill in the database name field with a valid value
Fill in the database username field with a valid value
Fill in the database password field with a valid value
Test the PostgreSQL connection
Change one of the connection fields to a different valid value
Test the PostgreSQL connection again
Verify the connection state reflects the updated details

title: Delete a history entry from the audit log
description: This verifies that a user can remove an analysis entry from history and see it disappear from the list.

steps.description: Navigate to /history
Delete an existing history entry
Confirm the deletion
Verify the deleted entry is no longer shown
Verify the history list remains accessible

title: Review and update local connector preferences
description: This verifies that a user can open the settings page and adjust local connector or authentication preferences.

steps.description: Navigate to /settings
Review the connector configuration section
Update a local application preference
Verify the updated preference is reflected on the page
Verify the connector configuration section remains visible

title: Handle incomplete PostgreSQL connection details
description: A user entering incomplete connection information sees validation feedback and can correct the form before testing again.

steps.description: Navigate to /settings
Fill in only part of the PostgreSQL connection form
Test the PostgreSQL connection
Verify connection validation feedback is visible
Complete the missing connection details
Test the PostgreSQL connection again
Verify discovered database objects are displayed

title: Recover from an invalid file upload
description: A user uploading an unsupported file type receives validation feedback and can successfully upload a valid dataset afterward.

steps.description: Navigate to /explorer
Upload an unsupported file type
Verify a file validation error is displayed
Upload a valid CSV or XLSX dataset file
Verify the dataset profile is displayed
